ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels occupying the central lobes and 25% low-intensity black pixels localized at the perimeter margins and median notch area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions spanning both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous boundary along the entire trailing edge and most of the leading edge. A dense cluster of dark pixels is visible at the median notch vertex. A distinct, isolated dark circular pixel cluster is located in the mid-right section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 50 degrees and a depth roughly 15% of the total fluke vertical profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the continuous linear boundary; peak-to-valley amplitude varies between 10-25 pixels across the trailing edge span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinctly concave curve fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes extending to the acute lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A single prominent dark circular pixel cluster (approximately 20 pixels in diameter) on the right lobe white field; secondary fine-grain dark speckling scattered across both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark circular spot on the right lobe surface; deep, irregular jagged notches at the distal tips of both lobes.
